original_variance.binary_comparison: Two retained binaries differed in 24 bytes: two bytes in the PE COFF TimeDateStamp, two bytes in each of three .rdata debug-directory timestamps, and the 16-byte RSDS CodeView/PDB GUID. PE timestamps matched their link times. .text, .data, .pdata, .rsrc and .reloc matched; the PDB path was the stable basename repopact_desktop.pdb; resources matched.
original_variance.root_cause: MSVC link.exe defaults embed link-time wall-clock timestamps and a newly generated CodeView identity. The observed differences were linker metadata, not source-path, resource, or application-section changes.
